name: auth0-forms-mcp-extension
description: An Auth0 Custom Extension that exposes Auth0 Forms through an MCP endpoint.
author: mustafadeel

scripts.build:extension: esbuild src/webtask.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/extension.js --alias:@auth0/agent-components=../auth0-agent-components/packages/agent-components/dist/index.js --alias:@auth0/agent-components/auth=../auth0-agent-components/packages/agent-components/dist/auth.js && mkdir -p build && cp dist/extension.js build/bundle.js
scripts.package: node scripts/create-extension-package.mjs && zip -j -q dist/package.zip dist/extension.js dist/package.json
scripts.build: rimraf dist .extension-build build/bundle.js && node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs && esbuild src/webtask.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/extension.js --alias:@auth0/agent-components=../auth0-agent-components/packages/agent-components/dist/index.js --alias:@auth0/agent-components/auth=../auth0-agent-components/packages/agent-components/dist/auth.js && mkdir -p build && cp dist/extension.js build/bundle.js && node scripts/create-extension-package.mjs && zip -j -q dist/package.zip dist/extension.js dist/package.json

AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.description: Canonical Auth0 tenant origin that issues MCP access tokens, for example https://tenant.us.auth0.com.

FORM_ID.description: Auth0 Form identifier exposed by this MCP server, for example ap_abc123.

AUTH0_FORMS_TRUST_SECRET.description: Shared secret used to mint trusted session tokens for a session-aware Form.

AUTH0_AUDIENCE.description: Audience of access tokens accepted by the MCP endpoint. Defaults to the deployed MCP URL.

FORMS_ORIGIN.description: Optional custom domain that serves the Auth0 Forms bundle. Defaults to AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.

FORM_NAME.description: Optional friendly name used in the MCP tool name.

FORM_DESCRIPTION.description: Optional instruction that tells the agent when to invoke this Form.
FORM_DESCRIPTION.example: Open this form when the user wants to set up their company profile.

FORM_SESSION_FIELD.description: Hidden Form field that receives a trusted session token. Leave empty for a no-session Form.

MCP_AUTH.description: Set to off only for a no-session development Form. Auth0 Bearer authentication is enabled by default.
